required_contract: Preserve omission or sign exactly one ReadOnly or ReadWrite mode.
Require a secure virtual-hosted target and bind the exact bucket to signing.
Preserve omission or validate one pinned encryption enum with coherent companions.
Bound the opaque key identifier and require an explicit compatible KMS mode.
Require bounded canonical Base64 and an explicit compatible KMS mode.
Preserve omission and accept only explicit true with a compatible KMS mode.
Preserve omission or decode one bounded singleton enum coherent with other encryption headers.
Preserve omission or decode one bounded singleton identifier only with KMS encryption.
Preserve omission or decode one bounded canonical Base64 singleton only with KMS encryption.
Preserve omission or decode canonical true only with KMS encryption.
Require exactly one strict bounded Credentials element containing every required nested member.
Require exactly one bounded nonempty access key and retain it only in the limited credentials object.
Require exactly one bounded nonempty secret and clear owned storage on finalization.
Require exactly one bounded nonempty token and sign its exact value as x-amz-s3session-token on later requests.
Require exactly one strict valid ISO-8601 timestamp and preserve its exact text.
